correctness.rationale: The zero-tie ambiguity is resolved by strict open-neighbor majority with retention. The symmetric epsilon-diagonal energy proves only periods one and two. All fixed and all-flipping words are classified by elementary rung constraints including n=2 boundaries. The 256-by-256 transfer counts ordered two-time pairs without double counting, and an explicit all-256-coordinate exact certificate proves an order-five recurrence. Five initial values determine the Lucas plus three-divisibility expression for all n>=2. Direct enumeration through n=10 and transfer checks through n=80 agree; neither finite range substitutes for the recurrence proof.

value.rationale: The open ladder is a canonical planar width-two graph family, structurally different from cyclic prisms, bare cycles and closed-neighbor ladder dynamics. Its exact *entire periodic point population* separates fixed and primitive two-cycle states and shows a genuine bounded three-divisibility resonance superposed on Fibonacci/Lucas growth. Counting all-vertex flips further reveals asymptotic scarcity within rapidly increasing two-cycle populations. These are natural and informative invariant quantities not implied by the period bound or previously found nearby enumeration.
